title: Add worktree-aware file discovery tool
description:
Implement a find_files tool that resolves paths relative to the current worktree context, not the base repo. This prevents the agent from wasting time on file operations that fail due to worktree path mismatches. The tool should return paths that work within the active git worktree.

Source: auto-review of attempt on VOYAGE-7
